title: Show where neighboring Hepatoplasmataceae genomes keep the same gene order
summary: Compare gene order across five Hepatoplasmataceae genomes. Start from the Web defaults, run LOSATP collinear blocks in the browser once, then color the blocks by identity and finish the layout, generating after each change.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Linear mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Linear mode before adding inputs.

manualSteps.title: Add the first genome
manualSteps.body: Download the five GenBank files listed under Files. In File 1, click the GenBank / DDBJ File box and choose AP027078.gb. Leave Organism / strain and Subtitle / title empty: the app reads the organism and isolate or strain from the file and draws them as the record's name line.

media.alt: AP027078.gb in the File 1 card, with empty Organism / strain and Subtitle / title fields, and Record options open to the region controls.
media.caption: Choose AP027078.gb in File 1 and leave Organism / strain and Subtitle / title empty.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const expected = ['AP027078.gb', 'AP027131.gb', 'AP027133.gb', 'AP027132.gb', 'NZ_CP006932.gb']; const names = (app?.linearSeqs || []).map((seq) => seq.gb?.name || ''); if (JSON.stringify(names) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) throw new Error('Hepatoplasmataceae GenBank order was not restored.'); const row = document.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-card="${app.linearSeqs[0].uid}"]`); const options = row?.querySelector(`[data-linear-record-options="${app.linearSeqs[0].uid}"]`); if (!row || !options) throw new Error('Hepatoplasmataceae Linear input row 1 was not found.'); options.open = true; const fileCard = row.closest('[data-linear-source-card]'); if (!fileCard) throw new Error('Linear file card was not found.'); fileCard.dataset.capture = 'hepatoplasmataceae-record-row'; fileCard.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Add the other four genomes
manualSteps.body: Click Add sequence, then choose the next file in the new File card. Add the files one at a time in the table order: LOSAT compares neighboring rows, so the order decides which genomes are compared.

media.alt: The File 5 card with NZ_CP006932.gb, above the Add sequence button.
media.caption: Click Add sequence, then choose the next file in the new File card; File 5 holds NZ_CP006932.gb.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.sidebarWidth = 480; const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-linear-source-card]')]; const add = document.querySelector('button[data-linear-file-add]'); const last = cards[cards.length - 1]; if (cards.length !== 5 || !add || !last) throw new Error('Five Linear File cards and Add sequence were not found.'); last.dataset.capture = 'hep-last-file-card'; add.dataset.capture = 'hep-add-sequence'; add.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

manualSteps.title: Generate with the defaults
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. Each genome is one row of CDS arrows on two strands, with the legend at the bottom. The name line left of each row, such as Ca. Tyloplasma litorale Fukuoka2020, comes from the organism and isolate or strain in the file. No comparison is drawn yet.

media.alt: Five Hepatoplasmataceae genomes as rows of CDS arrows with the Web defaults: organism name lines on the left, no comparison, and the legend at the bottom.
media.caption: Web defaults: five rows of CDS arrows with their name lines, no comparison yet.

manualSteps.title: Find collinear blocks with LOSATP
manualSteps.body: In Comparison, click Run LOSAT. Open Comparison Settings, press LOSATP under LOSAT Mode, and set LOSATP mode to Collinear blocks. Clear Max target seqs (Collinear blocks fills in 5) and select Build similarity groups with within-record searches. Click Generate Diagram. Collinear blocks join protein matches that keep the same local order between neighboring rows: blue for the same orientation, red for inverted.

rows: Build similarity groups with within-record searches

manualSteps.note: Change these settings before the first Generate: LOSAT runs once with them, and later Generates reuse its results. The first run searches 13 protein pairs in the browser (each neighboring pair in both directions, and each genome against itself) and can take several minutes. Performance in Comparison Settings stays at Auto execution, Safe total threads, and Auto threads per run.

manualSteps.title: Finish the layout
manualSteps.body: Open Layout and select Align to Center, Show GC Content, and Show GC Skew. In Axis & Scale, set Scale Style to Ruler (Ticks). In Colors, choose the ajisai palette. In Legend settings, set Legend position to Right, and clear Lock Definition Column. Click Generate Diagram to get the Gallery figure.
manualSteps.note: Everything else stays at the Web defaults: Track Layout Features on axis, Separate Strands on, Show Coordinate Scale on, and the collinear search values (Max unit gap 0, Min block genes 1, Diagonal drift 0, Merge conflicts 1, Search between Adjacent pairs, Bitscore 50, E-value 1e-2, Min identity 0, Min length 0).

losatTips.title: Start with Auto execution
losatTips.body: Auto uses threaded LOSAT only when the browser supports it and the workload justifies it.

losatTips.title: Prefer Safe total threads
losatTips.body: Safe leaves some logical CPUs unused so the browser can remain responsive.

losatTips.title: Keep Threads per run on Auto
losatTips.body: Auto lets the app balance parallel pair runs and per-run LOSATP threads from the selected total thread budget.

losatTips.title: Use Serial when the browser is constrained
losatTips.body: If threaded execution is unavailable or the tab becomes unresponsive, switch Execution to Serial or lower the thread budget.

losatTips.title: Reuse the cache
losatTips.body: The app reuses LOSAT results when the input files and LOSAT settings have not changed, so styling edits avoid another search.

troubleshooting.title: Threaded LOSAT is unavailable
troubleshooting.body: Use Auto or Serial execution. Some browser contexts disable SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation, which prevents threaded WebAssembly.

troubleshooting.title: The first run is slow
troubleshooting.body: LOSATP processes five genomes in the browser. Wait for the first cache entry before making styling-only changes.

troubleshooting.title: The output is cluttered
troubleshooting.body: Raise Min block genes or the identity threshold to retain fewer blocks, then regenerate.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Check the input order, the LOSAT settings of step 5 (set before the first Generate), Collinear color mode Orientation + identity, and the layout settings of step 7. Leave Organism / strain empty in each File card so the name lines come from the files.
